notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Gameplay:
Fireflies now carry over between levels

Improved tutorials for a smoother onboarding experience

You can now return to Farmland from the Rat Kingdom
Bug Fixes:
Fixed UI issues, including score display and overlapping menus

Fixed several spots where players could get stuck or leave the play area

notes.title: 1.0.1 First Day Patch Notes
notes.content:
Gameplay:
Rats are fully functional now and will chase Dillo to stop him from beating forts

Save System improved


Save system is fully implemented:
Compatible for all levels (Dillo Pad, Farmland, Rat Kingdom, Cave Fort, Rat King Fight )

Dialogues/Dialogue Sequencers

Destructibles

Ratkingdom stuff (bells, bellsystem, belltowerTrigger, pingajar),

Key Saves

Gates Saves

Respawn Points


Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where starting a new game with the menu while another game is running would cause you to respawn at the last respawn point of the level

Fixed an issue where saving inside a respawn point would lead to problems and messy behavior when loading the saved game

Auto-Save calls are added to Respawn Points, on level start, and at the end of forts

notes.title: Dillo's Dilemma is Here!
notes.content:
Hey, Explorers!
Dillo’s full adventure is here!

Roll, bounce, and ricochet your way through a pinball-infused love letter to classic adventure collectathons, where arcade nostalgia meets a fresh, fast-paced twist.


What’s in the full game?


Core Pinball-Adventure Mechanics – Master Dillo’s self-made roll ‘n’ ricochet gameplay.

Different Worlds – Explore large, open levels packed with secrets, puzzles, and hidden treasures.

Hand-Crafted Fort Levels – Race against the clock while swarms of rats chase you down.

Collect them all – Collect all fireflies scattered around the world!

Story and Antagonist – Discover the Dilemma that set Dillo on his journey and face the cunning Rat King!

New Friends & Foes – Team up with Frank the firefly and other armadillos on your quest to free the world.



You can also subscribe to our social media to find some more fun stuff about Dillo in the future!

Instagram

TikTok 



Thank you for rolling with us.

-MoonSpice Games

notes.title: Dillo's Demo is Here!
notes.content:
Hey, Explorers!

We’re rolling into Steam Next Fest with a demo of Dillo – our pinball-infused love letter to classic adventure collectathon games. Buckle up and be ready to bounce around, and feel that arcade nostalgia with a fresh twist!

What’s in the Demo?


Core Pinball-Adventure Mechanics – try out Dillo’s self-made roll ‘n’ ricochet gameplay.

Hand-Crafted Fort Level – test your skills and show how fast you can beat the level while swarms of rats keep behind your tail!

Feedback Provision – tell us what you loved (or what you hated). We would love to improve our game!



Coming after Demo
 

Online Co-op – you will be able to team up or troll friends while battling rat swarms. Push them into trouble or pull them to safety. Your choice to make!

More Forts – new challenges, more tricky ways to beat rats, and more objectives!

Collectables and World Challenges – more world challenges and collectables will await you when the game fully releases! Will you be able to find all the fireflies?

Story and Antagonist – you will find out why a certain mysterious and whimsical armadillo is occupying forts and supporting a rebellion.

 

Don’t forget to Wishlist and Follow to find out more about Armadillo named Dillo and his adventures

 

Full Release is August 2025!

You can also subscribe to our social media to find some more fun stuff about Dillo in the future!
Instagram

TikTok 



Thank you for rolling with us. We can’t wait to share even more exciting things soon!

-MoonSpice Games
